title: Heavy Rain on a Log Cabin Roof for Sleeping - No Thunder, No Music | 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of steady, heavy rain on a log cabin roof for deep sleep, reading or study. No thunder, no music, no talking, no mid-roll surprises in the sound: just rain on wooden shingles heard from inside a warm cabin.
The rain never loops. Every minute is freshly made, with a gentle fade in and a slow fade out at the end.
